pages.text: Some frogs carry mutations. Mutations are rarer than ordinary $(l:zen_amphibia:genetics/reading_genes)genes$(/l) and can unlock behavior, rendering, or future resource effects.

Known mutations include Ender and Creeper. Ender frogs can develop strange teleporting instincts, while Creeper frogs are marked for future volatile traits. Mutations can become part of long-term $(l:zen_amphibia:genetics/breeding_goals)breeding goals$(/l).
